newsitem.title: JAPAN: No plan for special stock announcement--Japan MOF.
newsitem.headline: No plan for special stock announcement--Japan MOF.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Tuesday it has no plans to make any special announcement to cope with the sagging Tokyo stock market.
A ministry official denied stock market rumours that Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka would announce measures to support the stock market at a news conference this morning.

"We have no plan for the minister to hold a special news conference. He is holding a regular conference but it has no special purpose (as speculated in the market)," the official told Reuters. The rumour briefly supported the market but the impact later petered out, traders said.
As of 0050 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 172.09 points or 0.98 percent at 17,308.25 after rising over 80 points to as high as 17,561.19 earlier in the morning, partly aided by the rumour.
An official at the Bank of Japan (BOJ) also said there is no plan at present for any special news conference or announcement by the central bank.
